description: A lever next to a crafter: pulse it and the crafter tries to craft its recipe.
blocked: the crafter needs a pulse to work (a lever holds the signal high), and a held lever is a circuit left active, which the safety rule forbids
notes: Bedrock 1.21+ has the crafter; the BDS in use (1.26.52) is new enough, but a lever is not a pulse source.
